summary: No evidence up to March 10, 2020 indicates a need to tighten, loosen, or add any covenant protections; the existing package remains appropriate.

clauses.rationale: Financial performance shows leverage within covenant bounds; no breach or trend suggesting adjustment of the leverage ratio floor.
Annual reporting requirements have been met consistently; no evidence of delayed or inadequate statements.
Quarterly reporting obligations have been satisfied; no signs of insufficient frequency or content.
Monthly reporting has been delivered as required; no evidence justifying a change in frequency or detail.
Notice provisions for defaults and material adverse effects have operated without issue; no triggering events suggest amendment.
Indebtedness restrictions align with observed borrowing activity; no violations or new debt types necessitate revision.

drift_reasons: All covenants remain supported by available evidence; no material changes in risk coverage, monitoring needs, or permitted behavior are indicated.
